title: Bitcoin M5 Trading Bot - Python for Exness MT5 Cent Account
description: Python trading bot using MetaTrader5 module. Trades BTCUSDC on M5 timeframe, Exness cent account. Fixed lot 0.01, spread cost 0.15 per trade.

entry_rules.long: RSI crosses above 40 (from below) AND price > 200 EMA
entry_rules.short: RSI crosses below 60 (from above) AND price < 200 EMA

indicator_components.name: MultiTimeframe_Alignment
indicator_components.rules: All three timeframes must agree on direction for entry.

exit_logic.trailing_stop: activate after +1.5% move, trail at 1.0× ATR
exit_logic.time_exit: close if no new high/low after 20 minutes (4 M5 candles)

risk_management.circuit_breaker: disable trading after 5 consecutive losses OR daily loss > 5%
risk_management.spread_cost_handling: subtract 0.15 USD from net profit after each trade close

python_implementation_notes.indicator_calculation: use pandas_ta or manual numpy/vectorized methods
python_implementation_notes.candle_check: poll every 5 seconds, detect new M5 candle via timestamps
python_implementation_notes.session_filter: check current server time (GMT) against London/NY sessions
python_implementation_notes.logging: log to file and console, include spread deductions

deployment_steps: Install MetaTrader5 package: pip install MetaTrader5
Run script while MT5 terminal is open and logged into Exness cent account
Ensure BTCUSDC symbol is visible in Market Watch
Test on demo cent account first
